package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type ProjectAuthoringFlowRepository interface {
	CreateOrGetProjectAuthoringFlow(context.Context, domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, bool, error)
	GetProjectAuthoringFlow(context.Context, string, string) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	GetProjectAuthoringFlowByKey(context.Context, string, string) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	GetCurrentProjectAuthoringFlow(context.Context, string, string, int64, string, int64, string) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	ConfirmProjectAuthoringFlow(context.Context, string, string, string, string, time.Time) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	RequestProjectPublication(context.Context, string, string, string, string, time.Time) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	ClaimNextProjectAuthoringFlow(context.Context, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	RenewProjectAuthoringClaim(context.Context, string, string, int64, time.Time, time.Time) error
	CheckpointTZAuthoringJob(context.Context, domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, string, string, domain.TZAuthoringJobStatus, time.Time) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error)
	MarkProjectAuthoringStaged(context.Context, domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, string, domain.TZAuthoringJob, time.Time) error
	MarkProjectAuthoringPublished(context.Context, domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, string, domain.ProjectPublicationReceiptV1, string, time.Time) error
	RetryProjectAuthoring(context.Context, domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
	FailProjectAuthoring(context.Context, domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, string, string, time.Time) error
}
